newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana bond panel approves eight bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana bond panel approves eight bond issues.

text.p: The Louisiana Bond Commission gave final approval Thursday to eight bond issues totalling $99.88 million, a commission spokeswoman said.

The commission also approved a $20 milion purchase agreement between the Office of State Purchasing and General Electric Capital Public Finance. The 18-month agreement extends the company's contract to finance portable equipment for state agencies.
--$32.6 million of Rapides Parish School Board general obligation refunding bonds for various school districts in the parish.
--$25 million of Jefferson Home Mortgage Authority mortgage revenue refunding bonds.
--$20 million of New Orleans Home Mortgage Authority single family mortgage revenue bonds.
--$13.5 million Lincoln Parish Police Jury exempt facility revenue bonds to finance construction of solid waste disposal facilities for the Williamette Industries Inc plant in Simsboro.
--$3 million of Rapides Finance Authority revenue bonds for the Louisiana College Project.
--$2.784 million Board of Trustees for State Colleges and Universities revenue bonds for a McNeese State University recreation complex.
--$1.5 million City of Alexandria revenue bonds to finance construction of a fabricated aluminum manufacturing facility for AFCO Industries Inc in Alexandria.
--$1.5 million Board of Trustees for State Colleges and Universities revenue bonds to expand parking facilities at McNeese State University.
